name: encoder-compute
description: Encoder-only levers: zero wire cost, decoder untouched, bytes unchanged. ac_nearest picks the AC code nearest in RECONSTRUCTION instead of nearest in the companded domain; scale_fit=1 normalizes by the dequantized scale the decoder actually uses (removing the shipped encoder/decoder scale mismatch); scale_fit=2 searches every scale code for minimum reconstruction SSE. Measured at the 21 B (ThumbHash-equal), 32 B (shipped tier 0) and 108 B (tier 1) budgets. Every arm pins all four selection/encoder knobs explicitly: this round measured the levers against the PRE-adoption constants, and since §10 adopted scale_fit=2 and ac_nearest=1 as defaults, an arm that omitted them would measure the levers against a control that already contained them.
